naming: FOR572 Advanced Network Forensics Poster (PCAP / Logs)
notes: Only artifacts Security Onion generates itself from traffic. No host agent, syslog ingest, or NetFlow export.
FOR572 poster piles are Full Packet Capture and Logs. SO does not generate NetFlow; conn.log is the NetFlow-like session view.
Default metadata engine is Zeek. If mdengine is set to SURICATA, protocol coverage is the shorter Suricata metadata set plus alerts and PCAP.
Extracted files and Strelka metadata are derived from PCAP/Zeek, same way carved objects come from a capture.
ICS/OT Zeek logs are included because SO ships parsers for them; they are not on the core FOR572 poster.

connection_and_session_logs: conn.log (TCP/UDP/ICMP connections, NetFlow-like view of traffic)
name_resolution_logs: dns.log (DNS queries and responses, passive DNS from the wire)
web_and_encrypted_web_logs: http.log (URLs, User-Agents, Referrers, MIME types, status codes)
file_transfer_and_mail_logs: files.log (files observed on the wire: hashes, MIME, size)
nids_alerts_and_sensor_notices: Suricata alerts (signature hits on the wire)
software_and_binary_metadata: pe.log (Windows PE metadata from transferred binaries)
files_extracted_from_traffic: Extracted files (carved from Zeek or Suricata)
industrial_control_protocol_logs: other ICS/OT Zeek logs shipped with Security Onion
